title: Novel Platform and Experiment Design for Intelligent Manufacturing Education
content: In recently years, diverse education platforms have been progressively established across various disciplines to support engineering practice. In addition, the teaching method to improve students’ practical ability is equally important. This paper presents a novel education platform from NCUT (North China University of Technology) and introduces corresponding teaching methods based on the platform to promote the practical ability in engineering students. Taking the manufacturing process of a rotary part as an example, this paper explains the virtual reality integrated method, which is an innovative approach to enhance students’ engagement during the practice sessions. Students are divided into several groups and collaborate to complete the practice. The study concludes that the virtual environment simulated by CAD (computer-aided design) software, serve as an excellent complement to the real-world equipment, enabling students to complete operations repeatedly without the constraints of time and space. The proposed virtual reality integrated education platform and corresponding teaching method significantly enhance students' engagement and practical skills.
